verdict.recommendedAction: Treat the geo-IP provider as the origin. Confirm its status with the vendor. Degrade gracefully: skip or cache geo enrichment while the provider is down and mark events un-enriched rather than rejecting them. Shorten the enrichment timeout below the gateway timeout so ingest-api does not hold requests for 20+ seconds. Keep the circuit breaker and monitor half-open probes. Backfill un-enriched events after recovery.
